provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.math.definition.selection against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:select, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_declaration, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:has_named_definition_body, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:definition_source, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:definition_blocks_select_multiple_complete_declarations_and_preserve_markdown, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:definition_blocks_reject_missing_wrong_kind_and_malformed_citations, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definitions_select_complete_equations_structure_literals_and_multiline_bodies, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definition_selection_ignores_comment_and_literal_decoys, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::definitions_reject_unsupported_incomplete_and_ambiguous_sources. select routes definitions to exact named extraction, which admits def/abbrev/structure/inductive and rejects wrong kinds, modifiers, attributes, ambiguous or incomplete forms. Bodies recognize documented equations, where and := forms. Tests compare complete multi-declaration output and exercise decoys, multiline bodies, missing targets and unsupported forms. The mutually recursive source restriction comes from meta.sources.exact_selection. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.sources.exact_selection.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
